question: Which packets and multiplicities belong to ordinary Haniel Skill/Burst casts?
stop_condition: Identify packets/multiplicities from saved descriptions and native arrays; use a disclosed bounded timing hypothesis if intervals are absent.
return_condition: New timing/reachability evidence changes Silent Moonlit Forest Guardian 2x Skill1_Damage or A Melody Named Haniel 1x Ultraskill1_Damage, Hootie speaker positioning, or Ensemble triggers.
decision: Silent Moonlit Forest Guardian describes 2 instances totaling 100%*2 at Lv1, matching native GE_Player_Haniel_Skill1_Damage (2 hits). A Melody Named Haniel describes 1 instance totaling 300% at Lv1, matching native GE_Player_Haniel_Ultraskill1_Damage (1 hit). Require each action's primary packet; schedule children once after admission with the admitted effective native coordinate. Each hit settles independently; on_cast enters Paranormal Ace state (10s, 14s at A2), A3 grants +20% Crit Rate, A5 grants +30% Psyche DMG bonus, and resonance_6 grants all allies +12% Crit Damage bonus across relevant hits.
timing_hypothesis: haniel.skill_burst_packets_v1: ordered coincident delivery on target zero at selected primary impact time. This supports packet totals and ownership, not native frame timing. Same-time delivery precedes queued gear callbacks; timing-sensitive results retain this assumption.
checks: Independent content damage oracles: at 1000 ATK/DEF.5/RES0, Skill levels 1/8/effective9 total 1000/1, 1714/1, 1851/1 (A3 resonance); Burst levels 1/8/effective9 total 1500/1, 5141/2, 5553/2 (A3 resonance).
Pending horizons, off-field ownership, dead/lethal targets, rejected energy admission and alternate primary are checked. Strict requires matching hypothesis acceptance.

Description and native arrays agree at all nine levels. Public two-Skill/one-Burst rotation produces 5 hits and spends 100 energy once; CLI/WASM/Worker agree. Full content, relevant character/gear web suites, replay and modeled awakening verifier pass.
No full kit/readiness claim. Normal chains, Hootie duration pause, Four-Part Harmony stacks, Ensemble AoE, and team ATK drain remain pending.
